title: KG-RAG improves recall over standard RAG for Czech public-health analytical scope retrieval
short_description: A controlled comparison where standard RAG retrieves text/table chunks directly, while KG-RAG first expands user disease-group and category phrases through MKN-10-CZ and code-list relations before retrieval and scope construction.
dataset: infectious_diseases primary table with MKN-10-CZ and age-group code lists as semantic support
example_questions: Porovnej střevní infekční nemoci v České republice podle diagnózy.
Porovnej střevní infekční nemoci v letech 2020 and 2023
Porovnej střevní infekční nemoci u dětí podle věkové skupiny.
Porovnej střevní infekční nemoci u seniorů 65+ podle věkové skupiny.
Porovnej střevní infekční nemoci na Moravě podle kraje.
Kolik případů střevních infekčních nemocí bylo v Praze?
Porovnej virové infekce kůže a sliznic podle diagnózy.
standard_rag_version: Embed and retrieve table-value chunks, row-group summaries, and metadata snippets; infer selected codes and dimensions from top-k retrieved text.
kg_rag_version: Link the user phrase to typed MKN/code-list entities, expand through code-label-hierarchy relations, constrain retrieval to expanded codes/dimensions, and expose the selected analytical scope before summarization.
expected_benefit_to_test: KG-RAG should improve recall for hard disease-family, age, and region-normalization questions, while matching standard RAG on easier control families.
baseline_retrieval_risk: A lexical proxy for `střev` retrieves only 4 of 9 in-table A01-A09 gold codes, and includes B81 outside the A00-A09 range.
risks: Standard dense RAG may recover more than the lexical proxy; this must be measured, not assumed.
Manual query paraphrase sets are required for fair recall evaluation.
KG expansion must mark A00 as absent from the infectious table rather than hallucinating rows.
Counts are reported case counts and must not be framed as prevalence, incidence, treatment guidance, or causal evidence.
